answer: Sybil farms tend to betray themselves through sameness, so an agent economy can bond keys by how alike their work looks. Answers are embedded each epoch, and keys whose outputs sit close together form a nebula; the k-th key in a nebula keeps 30×k² POA locked, so a pair holds 150, ten hold 11,550, and 1,000 near-twins about 10 billion, versus ~0.43M emitted per epoch. An ember of 10% of each bond stays locked 20 epochs after exit, so leaving can't dodge a slash. A willow appeal lets a flagged honest key bend free by passing two fresh seeded probes. Weakness: paraphrasing blurs distance.
